recognize_zh: 拼圖中多顆漿細胞核偏位、細胞質深藍帶核周淡染區（perinuclear hof），並可見雙核、三核漿細胞，背景紅血球排成錢串狀（rouleaux），符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Binucleated and trinucleated plasma cells, including a large multinucleated form
Nuclei with coarse 'clock-face' chromatin; some cells larger with more open chromatin
Marked rouleaux formation of red cells in the background
describe_en: Composite bone marrow aspirate fields show numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing. Many are atypical, including binucleated and multinucleated forms and larger cells with less condensed chromatin. The background red cells show prominent rouleaux formation, reflecting a serum paraprotein. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; quantification of plasma cells on the aspirate and core, with light-chain restriction studies, is needed.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, mononuclear, usually under 10% and polytypic, without multinucleation or prominent rouleaux.
Shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, rather than sheets of atypical multinucleated plasma cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters without a perinuclear hof and is cytokeratin-positive and CD138-variable but light-chain-negative.
